inclusion_rule: A file is published if a number reported in the manuscript or the supplement is stored in it, or if the Data availability statement promises it. A figure is published if a document includes it. Intermediate selection files and analyses no document reports are not published; they accompany the source code, supplied on request.

manuscript_files.results/metrics.csv: per-class measurements under the conventional rule
manuscript_files.results/metrics_logic_bearing.csv: the same classes with both counting rules side by side
manuscript_files.results/metrics_newcohort_logic.csv: the later model-and-prompt cohort, both rules
manuscript_files.results/sqj_revision.json: block audit, cutoff sensitivity, count models, leave-one-producer-out
manuscript_files.results/sqj_interaction.json: the size-adjusted rule change and the size-slope test
manuscript_files.results/oss_large.json: the repository study, and the pinned commit SHA for each repository
manuscript_files.results/additional/R5_duplicate_validati: block composition audit and agreement with jscpd
manuscript_files.results/additional/R11_specification_ech: specification-match rates and the cross-task permutation
manuscript_files.results/additional/R12_prior_rule_recomp: published duplication rules re-measured on this corpus

supplement_files.results/validation.json: S1: agreement with lizard over 6,540 name-matched methods
supplement_files.results/additional/E12_external_agreemen: S1: agreement with Pylint and Radon over all 1,183 classes
S2: the cross-task specification permutation, per producer and threshold
supplement_files.results/review_addenda.json: S3: Skillings-Mack with the tie correction, hurdle decomposition, alternative normalisations

S3: the count models refitted with task clustering respected
supplement_files.results/additional/E2_posthoc_dunn.json: S3: post-hoc producer pairs after correction
supplement_files.results/additional/E8_normalisation.json: S3: per class, per method and per unit WMC normalisations
supplement_files.results/syntactic_validity.json: S4: parse rates per producer, behind the attrition analysis
supplement_files.results/metrics_newcohort.csv: S5: the later cohort under the conventional rule
supplement_files.results/test_pass_newcohort.json: S5: test outcomes for the later cohort

redactions.results/additional/R5_duplicate_validati: The audited examples keep their file, producer, line numbers and line classification; their source lines are removed, because publishing those would redistribute the ClassEval generations.

not_included: source code (detector, mining pipeline, analysis scripts) - available from the corresponding author on request
ClassEval generations - available from the benchmark authors
mined repository contents - reconstructible from the pinned commit SHAs in results/oss_large.json
